sentences.text: By the present bail application, the applicant seeks pre- arrest bail in FIR No. 195/2025 dated 02.04.2025, registered at Police Station Greater Kailash, for offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. Chargesheet in the present case was filed without the State finding any need to arrest the applicant.

3. The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the application filed before the learned Trial Court under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, was disposed of only noting that the chargesheet has been filed without the arrest.
4. He submits that the applicant apprehends that he would be sent in custody.
6. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.

7. List on 28.07.2025.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J JULY 9, 2025 / 'KDK'
